systems.origin_category: new teaching material derived from specified primary rules
derivation_rules: Cook114 ðync(e)an has weak preterite ðūhte; prefix of- is lexical in Ex49 grieve. Selected present syncopated indicative ofðyncð, subjunctive ofðynce; both past moods ofðūhte.

The four cells exhaust this deliberately bounded third-singular impersonal system. A dative experiencer is not a nominative subject and does not trigger personal/plural agreement. A cause clause fills the impersonal subject position under190. No unrestricted personal conjugation is introduced.
